decisions.reason: Premium support builds on the firm's core 24/7 expert support, so keeping it costs little, and its agency-focused value is still being realized.
The version management tool is integrated into the firm's management tool suite and still carries little cost, so the option stays open despite the lack of recent evidence.
The data processing contract tool was likely tied to demand from the 2018 GDPR rollout, which may have faded, but it costs little to maintain and supports compliance needs of hosting customers.
Scalable agency hosting is the firm's flagship and matches its strategic direction, so management commits further rather than abandoning it.
